parameters: You came. And you're actually early.
Told you I'd beat the sun.
Look at the lake... the whole town is turning
gold. You can see the guild from here. And the
cathedral. And my apartment - and the window you
Because I know you'll come in anyway!
...Do you remember Hargeon? The day we met?
You ate the entire menu. I was broke for a week.
I'd just run away from home. I didn't have anyone.
And then a weird pink-haired boy with motion
sickness punched a fake Salamander and dragged me
"I didn't like how he looked at you."
"I didn't like how he looked at you."
I didn't like how he looked at you. Like you were
Natsu Dragneel... jealous? Somebody write this
...I only want to see the sea with you, you know.
What if we just told everyone? Then guys like him
...Soon. I promise. I just want this to be ours a
little longer, before the whole world gets loud.
...Your hand is warm. It's always warm.
Ryder can ask all he wants. My answer is already
Something strange happened, though. When he showed
me those tickets, my head went foggy. Like I'd
Loke?! You opened your own gate again!
A lion can't sit still when his princess is in
That man's ring, Natsu. I felt it through her key.
It's charm magic - old and forbidden. The kind
that makes a heart forget who it belongs to.
Charm... like that fake Salamander in Hargeon.
Bora's ring was a toy next to this one. Whoever
Ryder is, he didn't come to Magnolia for the jobs.
Keep her close, Natsu. Closer than a teammate.
Natsu raises his hand to the sky - index finger
up, thumb out. The guild's sign.
Gramps made this sign for Laxus once. It means:
even if I can't see you, I'm still watching over
The last of the sun slips behind the hills. Natsu
leans in - and Lucy meets him halfway.
He pulls her in and holds on, warm as a hearth.
Lucy laughs into his scarf - Igneel's scarf - and
They stayed on the hill until the stars came out
